summary.text: Karen Hurd is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 69 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Roger Halls and independent Joshua Kelley.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nutrition counseling.

paragraphs.text: Karen Hurd was born in Houston, Texas, and lives in Fall Creek, Wisconsin.
She graduated from Kirkwood High School in 1976, served in the U.S. Army from 1980 to 1984, and earned a B.A., summa cum laude, in languages from Truman State University in 1980.
She later obtained a degree in comprehensive nutrition from the American Academy of Nutrition and an M.S. in biochemistry from the University of Saint Joseph in 2017.
Her career experience includes nutrition counseling and speaking engagements, creating nutritional and biochemical eCourses, and writing on those topics.
Hurd's Ballotpedia profile gives her Assembly tenure as beginning in 2023.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as the Finance Committee and the Joint Finance Committee.
